backend:litellm-ollama.detail: litellm not installed (optional: uv sync --extra litellm)

nodes.label: Client
nodes.about: Any OpenAI-compatible client: the playground, the AEGIS assistant, Veritas, NEXUS.

nodes.label: Auth
nodes.about: Checks the API key and finds the tenant it belongs to.

nodes.label: Guardrails
nodes.about: Redacts personal data and blocks prompt-injection attempts before anything else sees the prompt.

nodes.label: Rate limiter
nodes.about: Token bucket per key in Redis: tokens per minute, 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

nodes.label: Budget
nodes.about: Monthly spend per tenant in est. cloud-equivalent dollars: warns at the soft limit, blocks at the hard one.

nodes.label: Exact cache
nodes.about: Same tenant, model, messages and parameters as before: replay the stored answer instantly.

nodes.label: Semantic cache
nodes.about: A paraphrase of an earlier question in the same conversation: replay its answer if cosine >= threshold.

nodes.label: Embedder
nodes.about: bge-small on the CPU inside the gateway, so a model-server crash cannot take out the cache.

nodes.label: Coalescer
nodes.about: Identical requests in flight at once share one upstream call.

nodes.label: Router
nodes.about: Picks the first backend in the chain with a closed breaker and a free slot; busy is not broken.

nodes.label: Hedger
nodes.about: No first token by the backend's p95 TTFT? Fire the same request at the next backend; first token wins.

nodes.label: Stream relay
nodes.about: Relays tokens to the client as Server-Sent Events from an async generator.

nodes.label: Ledger queue
nodes.about: Usage rows and cache writes go to a background queue, never the request path.

nodes.label: SQLite ledger
nodes.about: One row per request, written in batches by a background task.

nodes.label: MLX primary
nodes.about: mlx serving mlx-community/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit at http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1

nodes.label: Ollama fallback
nodes.about: ollama serving llama3.2:3b at http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1

nodes.label: LiteLLM adapter
nodes.about: litellm serving ollama_chat/llama3.2:3b at http://127.0.0.1:11434

nodes.label: Redis Stack
nodes.about: Exact cache, HNSW vector index, rate-limit buckets and budgets.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry -> Jaeger
nodes.about: One trace per request, one span per stage, GenAI semantic conventions, OTLP export.

nodes.label: Chaos controller
nodes.about: Dev-only fault injection: latency, error rate, freeze a backend.
